claude_proposed_widenings.name: decrease_exhaustion_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: SRD Exhaustion has levels 1–6; reducing by one level is mechanically distinct from remove_condition (which removes exhaustion entirely). No existing atom covers partial level reduction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation trigger: on_short_rest
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: PassiveOperation.trigger currently only supports elapsed_time. Tireless' Decrease Exhaustion fires on short-rest completion, which is a rest event not an elapsed-time event.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.
